leafFix: Functional bounded page-derived leaf extraction/redaction, public schema unchanged.
cross: Diagnostic only, no terminal protocol/ownership/order/promotion/rejection behavior changes.
stopCross: Stop on first unequivocal causal failure; otherwise stop after five actual attempts.

classificationRule: Cross failure diagnostic records must locate exact branch; don't treat passing diagnostics as resolution.
